Compassionate Cat & Dog Oncology Services
in Denver, CO
A cancer diagnosis can feel overwhelming, but you and your pet are not alone. At Platt Park Veterinary Hospital, we’re here to walk beside you with open hearts, open communication, and the expert care your pet needs to face their next chapter with strength and comfort.
Our in-house oncology services are designed to offer advanced diagnostics, personalized treatment plans, and emotional support in one familiar, compassionate space. With state-of-the-art technology, collaborative specialists, and a deep commitment to quality of life, we help you make informed decisions that align with your goals and your pet’s unique needs.
If your pet has been diagnosed with cancer, or you're seeing signs that concern you, reach out today. Give us a call at
(303) 879-1090
or book online.
Call Us
Advanced Pet Cancer Diagnostics in Denver
Accurate, timely diagnosis is the first step toward effective treatment, and we’ve invested in the tools and expertise to make that process as smooth and informative as possible. Our full suite of in-house diagnostics means we can gather clear answers quickly, often within the same day.
Here’s what we offer on-site to get answers fast:
Full-body CT scans
using our in-house computed tomography scanner to screen for tumors, internal abnormalities, or cancer staging
State-of-the-art tumor screening with DNA analysis,
which helps us identify cancer type and develop targeted, personalized treatment plans
In-house cytology
using the HeskaView Single Slide Scanner, which allows same-day evaluation by board-certified pathologists
Nu.Q® Cancer Screening Test
, an advanced blood test that helps detect early signs of some cancers in dogs
Sedated biopsies
for safe, comfortable sample collection
Digital X-rays and ultrasound
for internal imaging and mass evaluation
Comprehensive labwork
including CBC, chemistry panels, and other cancer-relevant markers
Personalized Cancer Treatments for Cats and Dogs
Cancer care isn’t one-size-fits-all. That’s why our team works closely with you to create a treatment plan that meets your pet’s medical needs while respecting their comfort, personality, and your family’s goals.
Treatment options available at Platt Park include:
Oral and IV chemotherapy
tailored to your pet’s cancer type and tolerance
Electrochemotherapy
, a localized therapy that enhances the effectiveness of chemo with fewer systemic side effects
Immunotherapy
, including anti-tumor vaccines and Elias Immunotherapy for osteosarcoma, offering new hope without traditional chemotherapy
Palliative care
focused on comfort, appetite, mobility, and quality of life for pets not undergoing active treatment
Surgical collaboration
with our
surgery
team for tumor removals and biopsy procedures
Radiation therapy referrals
coordinated with trusted specialists in the Denver area, so your pet’s care remains seamless and supportive
We’re in This Together
Navigating cancer can feel like unfamiliar territory, but at Platt Park Veterinary Hospital, you have a team beside you who truly cares. From diagnosis to treatment and every decision in between, we’re here to provide expert guidance, genuine support, and unwavering compassion.
Have questions? Want to schedule a consultation? Call us anytime at
(303) 879-1090
or book online. We’re here to listen, support, and help you move forward with confidence.
